title: Boca Grove

services.name: Pool & Cabanas
services.desc: Our resort style pool features dedicated lap lanes as well as a shallow beach entry for relaxing in the water while soaking up the sun. A child play area sits adjacent to the pool and playground area, where little ones can explore and splash. Resort style seating surrounds the pool, including covered cabana seating

blurb: Boca Grove is the epitome of superior living. Nestled away and conveniently situated in the heart of Boca Raton, this prestigious, members-only golf, and country club offers a boutique-style residential community and a recreational escape from the everyday. Boca Grove is renowned as one of South Florida’s most affluent and desirable communities, exuding understated elegance in an intimate setting.
